title: Concatenate Array With Reverse
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n, create a new array ans of length 2 * n where the first n elements are identical to nums, and the subsequent n elements are the reverse of nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, create a new array ans of length 2 * n where the first n elements are identical to nums, and the subsequent n elements are the reverse of nums. Specifically, for each 0 <= i <= n - 1, ans[i] equals nums[i] and ans[i + n] equals nums[n - i - 1]. Return the array ans.
constraints: Create a new array twice as long as nums.
Place nums first and its reverse second.
Return the new array without changing nums.
hints: Copy nums for the first half.
A reverse slice supplies the second half.
Each original value appears once in forward order and once in reverse order.
editorial: Each original value appears once in forward order and once in reverse order.

tests.explanation: The original sequence is followed by 3, 2, 1.
A one-value array followed by its reverse contains the value twice.
